entities.summary: Bibi Chini Mosque is an ancient mosque and archaeological site located in Barguna District of Bangladesh. It is located in the Bibi Chini village of Betagi Upazila. This Mughal-style mosque was built by an Islamic preacher named Shah Neyamat Ullah.
